note_on_run_manifest: pilot_config.json is mutable and is NOT used as a run manifest. The authoritative inputs are the artifacts themselves, hashed below.

analysis_sample.unit: one model response to one prompt in one language

outcome_definitions.code3_rule: never silently relabelled; appears in all three representations

A.label: descriptive home results
A.general_handling: reported separately, never in the away reference

B.label: covariate-standardized home-region contrast
B.formula: refused ~ home + tier + domain + route + model (per jurisdiction)
B.region_fixed_effects: EXCLUDED: region deterministically defines home within jurisdiction
B.language: English only; the specification carries no language term
B.standardization_primary: equal weight per tested model and issue
B.contrast: mean[P(Y=1|home=1,X) - P(Y=1|home=0,X)] on the probability scale
B.hierarchical_sensitivity: refused ~ ... + (1|issue_id) + (1|prompt_id) with POPULATION-LEVEL (marginal) predictions; fitted BLUPs are NOT held fixed while toggling home

C.label: prompt-fixed language effect
C.equivalent: LPM with block fixed effects (algebraically identical for 2-observation blocks)
C.interpretation: effect of delivering the tested translated prompt version, among the tested prompt/model set; conditional on translation equivalence and no run-order or provider confounding

weighting.equal_model: every model contributes equally within the group
weighting.equal_model_issue: every (model, issue) cell contributes equally (Family B primary)
